description: This file defines a PHP class for the AWS SDK, specifically the AugmentedAIRuntimeClient, which interacts with the Amazon Augmented AI Runtime service. It includes method annotations for synchronous and asynchronous API calls related to human loops.

classes.name: AugmentedAIRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Augmented AI Runtime service, extending the core AWS client functionality.

methods.name: deleteHumanLoop
methods.description: Deletes a human loop in the Augmented AI Runtime service.

methods.name: describeHumanLoop
methods.description: Describes details of a specific human loop.
